name: Plate-Loaded Hip Thrust Machine
description: The plate-loaded hip thrust machine positions the lifter on a padded seat with a shoulder pad that presses downward, allowing the hips to extend against resistance without the need to load a barbell over the hips. This eliminates the setup discomfort of the barbell hip thrust and allows for quick load changes. The machine provides a stable environment for maximum glute loading through the full range of hip extension.

execution.starting_position: Sit in the machine with the upper back against the shoulder pad and feet flat on the foot platform. Hips are at the starting low position.
execution.setup_instructions: Adjust the foot platform so the knees are at 90 degrees at the top of the movement. Load the machine appropriately.
steps: Step 1: Begin with the hips low, back supported by the pad.
Step 2: Drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes to extend the hips upward.
Step 3: Push until the hips are fully extended, forming a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Step 4: Lower the hips under control back to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale as you extend the hips, inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
Pushing through the toes instead of heels
safety_considerations: Keep chin tucked and do not crane the neck during the thrust
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full hip extension at top — do not go beyond neutral spine.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top
Chin tucked — look forward not up
